subject: history
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: The 1956 crisis triggered by Egypt's nationalisation of a key waterway is known as what?
questions.explain: The Suez Crisis of 1956 followed Nasser's nationalisation of the Suez Canal.

questions.q: The 1973 war launched by Egypt and Syria on a Jewish holy day is known as what?
questions.explain: The Yom Kippur War of 1973 began with a surprise Arab attack on Israel.

questions.q: Who was the Egyptian leader who nationalised the Suez Canal in 1956?
questions.explain: Gamal Abdel Nasser nationalised the Suez Canal in 1956.

questions.q: The 1967 war in which Israel captured the Sinai, West Bank and Golan Heights is called what?
questions.explain: The Six-Day War of 1967 saw Israel make major territorial gains.

questions.q: Which Israeli Prime Minister signed the Oslo Accords and was assassinated in 1995?
questions.explain: Yitzhak Rabin signed the Oslo Accords and was assassinated in 1995.

questions.q: What term describes the Palestinian uprisings against Israeli occupation that began in 1987?
questions.explain: The First Intifada was a Palestinian uprising starting in 1987.

questions.q: In which year was the state of Israel created?
questions.explain: The State of Israel was declared on 14 May 1948.

questions.q: The 1978 talks brokered by US President Carter between Egypt and Israel are known as what?
questions.explain: The Camp David Accords of 1978 led to peace between Egypt and Israel.

questions.q: Who chaired the PLO for decades, becoming the face of the Palestinian cause?
questions.explain: Yasser Arafat led the Palestine Liberation Organisation from 1969.

questions.q: In which year were the Oslo Accords signed, with a famous Rabin-Arafat handshake?
questions.explain: The Oslo Accords were signed in 1993.

questions.q: The 1948-49 war that followed Israel's creation is remembered by Palestinians as the what?
questions.explain: Palestinians call the 1948 displacement the 'Nakba', meaning catastrophe.
